# requireAdmin

<link-summary>Stops the call unless the current user is a Workspace administrator.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireAdmin() — Stops the call unless the current user is a Workspace administrator. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/admin</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireAdmin(message?: string): void;
```

The assertion form of `isAdmin`, and the one to put at the top of anything destructive. It returns nothing: either the call continues or it does not.

## Parameters

| Parameter              | Type     | Description                                                   |
| :--------------------- | :------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `message` _(optional)_ | `string` | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`void` — nothing; it either passes or throws.

## Throws

| Exception                | Condition                                |
| :----------------------- | :--------------------------------------- |
| `AuthorizationException` | the active user is not an administrator. |

## Examples

### Guarding an action

```javascript
function deleteEverything() {
  requireAdmin("Only an administrator may run this.");

  // …
}
```
